metadata.temperature_kind: climatology (long-term monthly averages, NOAA OISST style)
metadata.TODO: Replace monthly_sst_c (and regenerate weekly_sst_c) with real NOAA OISST v2.1 climatology aggregated per basin polygon; replace destination monthly_sst_offset_c with coastal-station or high-res satellite data. Values below are hand-curated approximations for seeding only.
metadata.monthly_convention: monthly_sst_c[0..11] = Jan..Dec mean SST, anchored at mid-month (day-of-year 15, 45, 74, 105, 135, 166, 196, 227, 258, 288, 319, 349)
metadata.weekly_convention: weekly_sst_c[0..51] = weeks 1..52, each value sampled at the week midpoint (day-of-year 7*w+4) by linear interpolation between mid-month anchors, wrapping Dec->Jan. Use these for date-range queries (e.g. Jun 11-17 spans weeks 24-25) instead of whole-month figures.
metadata.offset_convention: destination local SST = sea monthly_sst_c + monthly_sst_offset_c (interpolate offsets the same way for weekly precision)
metadata.notes: Ranking key is temperature only; tourism_score ranks destinations within a sea. Dead Sea intentionally excluded. Lakes included as type='lake'.
